caseName: Sutton v. Joint Bar Ass'n Grievance Committee for the Second & Eleventh Judicial Districts
caseNameFull: Sutton v. Joint Bar Association Grievance Committee for the Second and Eleventh Judicial Districts

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 2d Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
